name: Belt
what_i_did: A leather strap closed into an oval, 10 bronze plaques with a raised leaf rib each, bronze ribs between them, an octagonal sunburst buckle plate at the front, and a buckle frame, prong, strap end and keeper at the side.
good: Outline match 0.85: the oval, the plaque rhythm, the octagonal sunburst plate and the buckle at the back all read.
Leather and bronze are separate named materials, so the game can shade them differently.
off: The concept's laurel relief is a full embossed wreath; at game size it is one raised leaf rib per plaque.
The concept's band is taller and tapers towards the buckle; mine is an even 7 cm.
The bronze ribs poke slightly above the strap edge, which the concept doesn't do.
creative_additions: A leather keeper loop that holds the free strap end, and the sunburst rays alternating long and short.

rounds.t: First build: plaques hidden inside the strap.
Plaques pushed out (1.6 cm) over a wider arc; boss enlarged to 6.4 cm; buckle and keeper added.

score.method: silhouette IoU after bounding-box normalising both masks; camera found by grid search on the model, so a guide
